name: Text Summarizer
tagline: Summarize any text in one click
description: Paste in an article, notes, or any long passage and get a concise AI-generated summary. Summarization runs in a Python Executa that asks the Anna host to sample an LLM via reverse sampling, so the app never holds its own model credentials.
_comment_bundled_executas: Executas that ship inside this app. `anna-app apps publish` publishes each one first, then substitutes its server-minted tool_id into every `bundled:<handle>` reference in manifest.json (in memory — the file on disk is never mutated). The `text-summarizer` handle maps to ./executas/text-summarizer.
